project.name: EszterGyori
scopeFacts: Next.js frontend is exported as static files; Node is build-time only in production.
PHP is the only production backend and serves the same-origin /api surface.
Editorial content is authoritative JSON; operational state is MySQL; managed media use filesystem plus an authoritative catalog.
Production includes admin authentication/sessions, booking, managed media uploads, a durable notification queue, one cron dispatcher and SMTP.

Production target is Hetzner shared webhosting; there is no production container runtime, service mesh, owned distributed-service topology, high-availability/failover topology, feature-flag system, artifact registry, vector/AI pipeline or autoscaling/load-balancing layer.

semantics.ACTIVE: The domain has at least one V1 project-scope trigger. Its atomic controls are evaluated from the pinned baseline using their O/A/R class and applicability trigger. ACTIVE is not PASS.
semantics.N/A: No project-specific A/R trigger exists for this domain in the current V1 scope. Universal O controls in the pinned baseline are still evaluated and are never waived by this domain prefilter. A scope change invalidates the N/A decision.
semantics.reinforcement: R controls remain non-blocking unless an explicit project decision promotes them.
semantics.gateRule: FAIL or NOT VERIFIED on an O control or a triggered A control blocks the corresponding baseline gate. N/A without justification is invalid. NOT RUN is never PASS.

notApplicableDomains.ARCH-17: Production has one owned application/backend boundary (static frontend + same-origin PHP API) rather than an owned distributed-service topology; SMTP/MySQL are covered as backing/external services.

notApplicableDomains.DEL-13: The production delivery unit targets Hetzner shared webhosting and contains no container image/runtime; Docker Compose is only a local disposable development dependency.
notApplicableDomains.DEL-25: V1 has no feature-flag system or flag-controlled release path.
notApplicableDomains.DEL-30: V1 publishes no package/container artifact to a registry or public package repository; the production archive is deployed directly to the hosting target.

notApplicableDomains.OPS-26: V1 makes no high-availability or automated failover promise and has no redundant production topology; backup/restore/disaster recovery remain active separately.

notApplicableDomains.DATA-23: V1 contains no embeddings, chunking pipeline, vector store or search-derived vector index.
notApplicableDomains.DATA-24: V1 has no event stream, event log, CDC pipeline or streaming consumer; the notification table is an operational job queue, not an event-sourcing/CDC authority.
notApplicableDomains.DATA-27: V1 defines no analytics warehouse, analytical dataset or business-KPI data product.
notApplicableDomains.DATA-31: V1 has no application-level replica, multi-region store, sharding or multi-writer data topology.
notApplicableDomains.DATA-36: V1 contains no AI/ML training/evaluation dataset and persists no model-generated data.

notApplicableDomains.PERF-26: V1 runs on fixed Hetzner shared webhosting and has no application-controlled autoscaling or load-balancing layer.
